question: Who among the following is the in charge of the Union Territories in the absence of the Chief Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lieutenant Governor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lieutenant Governor** is the in charge of the Union Territories in the absence of the Chief Minister.
 
• In Union Territories where there is no legislative assembly, the Lieutenant Governor acts as the administrator appointed by the President of India.
